channel.title: Notification Channels on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Notification Channels on KubeSphere

item.title: Set Email Notification
item.description: This section describes how to set up email notifications. Prerequisites You need to have the platform-admin role in the KubeSphere platform. For more information, refer to Users and Platform Roles. The WizTelemetry Notification extension needs to be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has the platform-admin role.

item.title: Configure Feishu Notification
item.description: This section describes how to configure Feishu notification. The Feishu notification feature supports sending notifications to users in the following two ways: Session Settings: Use a Feishu app to send notifications to specific users or departments. Group Bot Settings: Use a Feishu bot to send notifications to specific group chats. Prerequisites The KubeSphere platform needs to have the WizTelemetry Notification extension installed and enabled.

item.title: Configure DingTalk Notification
item.description: This section describes how to configure DingTalk notification. The DingTalk notification feature supports sending notifications to users in the following two ways: Session Settings: Use a DingTalk app to send notifications to specific users or departments. Group Chat Bot Settings: Use a DingTalk bot to send notifications to specific group chats. Prerequisites The WizTelemetry Notification extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform.

item.title: Configure WeCom Notification
item.description: This section describes how to configure WeCom notification. After configuration, you can receive notification messages through WeCom sessions or group bots. Prerequisites The WizTelemetry Notification extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to obtain the access parameters for the application or group bot from the WeCom platform in advance. For more information, refer to WeCom Developer Documentation. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has the platform-admin role.

item.title: Set Up Slack Notifications
item.description: This section describes how to set up Slack notifications. Prerequisites The WizTelemetry Notification extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to obtain the application access parameters from the Slack platform in advance. For more information, refer to the Slack Developer Documentation. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has the platform-admin role.

item.title: Set Webhook Notification
item.description: This section describes how to set up Webhook notification. Prerequisites The WizTelemetry Notification extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to obtain the access parameters for the Webhook in advance. For more information, please contact your Webhook administrator. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has the platform-admin role.
